_README.what: The E-Kat spend table, verbatim from Sieg's Guide. Rendered on the character sheet as an 'E-Kat Exchange' section at the TOP of class features, so a player can see what their reserve actually buys without opening the Doc.
_README.why_data_not_code: This is rule TEXT the sheet displays, not behaviour. Per the docs doctrine the generator owns behaviour and data owns content; keeping the table here means correcting a wording is a data edit, and validate_luck.py can gate the roster against the Doc.
_README.order_matters: A list, not an object: the rows render in the Doc's own order, cheapest first, with the two 99-E-Kat capstones last.
_README.in_play_only: Nothing here is applied at generation. The generator spends the starting reserve on Luck Traits (25 each) and exports the remainder; every other row is a table action the GM adjudicates.
_README.cross_check: The 25-E-Kat row is the one the generator acts on -- luck.LUCK_TRAIT_COST must agree with it, and validate_luck.py asserts that.
_README.ascii_labels: Labels are ASCII on purpose. They become KEYS in the class-features block, and keys travel through the FoundryVTT module's name matching -- a stray em-dash or arrow is exactly the casing/character mismatch that has orphaned rows in this stack before.

rows.label: 2 E-Kats: bonus
rows.text: Gain a +1 on ANY roll; +2 if declared before the roll.

rows.label: 2 E-Kats: penalty
rows.text: Inflict a -1 on ANY roll; -2 if declared before the roll.

rows.label: 5 E-Kats: stabilize
rows.text: Stabilize ANYONE within five feet, provided they are not already beyond stabilization.

rows.label: 10 E-Kats: hero point
rows.text: Use as a Hero Point (you can store it if you have room).

rows.label: Hero point for 5 E-Kats
rows.text: 1 non-temporary Hero Point can be exchanged for 5 E-Kats (not multiplied by Lucky Boy).

rows.label: 20 E-Kats: borrow a feat or spell
rows.text: Gain the ability to use a feat or mythic spell you qualify for, excluding the mythic requirement. Feats last one minute; spells last for the duration of the spell.

rows.label: 25 E-Kats: Luck Trait
rows.text: 25 permanent E-Kats can be used to purchase a Luck Trait.

rows.label: 99 E-Kats: Destined Template
rows.text: Gain the "Destined" Template (only once per player). This action locks your slot into a future campaign and ties it to this character.

rows.label: 99 E-Kats: survive anything
rows.text: You may exchange 99 E-Kats to survive anything.
